**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, including manual workarounds.

**Which area does it touch?**
- [ ] Catalog & taxonomy (job families, relation graph)
- [ ] Profile / fit engine
- [ ] Postings / Explore / connectors
- [ ] CV Studio / cover letters
- [ ] Interview prep / assessments
- [ ] Chat / AI system
- [ ] Desktop app
- [ ] Self-hosting / deployment
- [ ] Other

**Additional context**
Screenshots, mockups, or links that help explain the idea.
